feature_groups.evidence: Notably, payload data is not always encrypted; for instance, Client Hello and Server Hello packets contain key plaintext information from the TLS handshake.

model_family.evidence: Open-Detect leverages variational autoencoders (VAEs) and Gaussian prototypes to achieve fine-grained classification of known traffic categories and effective detection of unknown malicious traffic
